theme: Dark Mode Elegant (Premium, Urban, Jovem, Fast)

headings.style: tracking-tight, font-bold, impactful, gold and white variations

body.scale: text-base for normal, text-sm for labels

colors.notes: No pure black/gray, slight warm tint. Gold/Yellow represents the Barão identity/crown. Red/Orange for hookah/fire details.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with subtle gold/gray borders (border-white/10 or border-[#D4AF37]/20). Solid surfaces for product cards with soft shadows and crisp borders.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Translate-y-1, glow effect on borders (gold/red), image zoom in on hover for product cards.
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle smoke effect (CSS particles, soft layered box-shadows, or Framer motion) in Tabacaria section, pulse animation on floating WhatsApp button. Loading crown animation on start.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for sharp, premium duotone/regular icons (default).

layouts.hero: Impactful full-height or 80vh hero. Dark overlay over background image (bg-black/50 to bg-black/70), gold typography, multiple CTAs (WhatsApp primary).
layouts.categories: Grid layout. Bento-style for combinations. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 for categories (Bebidas, Tabacaria, Combos, Gelo).
layouts.catalog: Grid layout with sidebar or top bar filters. Product cards must be highly usable on mobile (Mobile First layout: 1 col on mobile, 3-4 on desktop).
layouts.admin_panel: Strict, dense grid hierarchy. Sidebar navigation. High contrast for readability. No glassmorphism, use solid dark surfaces for admin.

components.header: Sticky with glassmorphism. Logo with crown left, nav links center, WhatsApp CTA right. Nav links visible on desktop.
components.product_card: Dark surface (#1A1A1A), subtle border. Image top, Title, Price (gold text), CTA 'Adicionar' or 'Comprar via WhatsApp' button.
components.cart_modal: Slide-in from right. High density, clear checkout CTA routing to WhatsApp.
components.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right, z-50, continuous pulse animation, brand green or brand gold.
components.carousel: Use embla-carousel-react for 'Combos' and 'Promoção do Dia'. Large, eye-catching cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text must still be legible.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a gold ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

bebidas.description: Hand holding pint of beer, dark background (Use for Bebidas category)

tabacaria.description: Hookah vases with dark background (Use for Tabacaria section/category)

combos.description: Cocktails in dark setting (Use for Combos/Party drinks)

gelo_carvao.description: Ice cubes on dark background (Use for Gelo/Carvão category)

hero_bg.description: Orange light on dark room, great for a moody hero background with gold/orange accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React components, as the project uses JS, not TS.
Design mobile-first with high interactivity. Do not compromise loading speed with overly heavy 3D elements, use Framer Motion for sleek transitions and micro-interactions.
Implement a loading screen featuring a crown logo/icon before the main site loads.
The Hero section must have a strong Call to Action (CTA) pointing to WhatsApp: '(66) 99257-5143'.
For the Tabacaria section, incorporate subtle smoke-like background effects or gradients using CSS/Framer Motion.
Checkout must occur via WhatsApp. The cart should collect the user's name, observations, and products, generating a formatted WhatsApp message.
Provide a full Admin Dashboard for CRUD operations (products, categories, promotions).
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs).
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for the header when it overlaps with content. Use backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent dark background like bg-black/60.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Radix/Shadcn UI components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity and transform.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Do not use AI emoji characters for icons.
Include micro-animations (hover states, transitions, entrance animations).
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than standard).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
